name: Pacer Electronics
old_description: Welcome to Pacer Electronic Wire & Cable, Inc. We appreciate your visit to our Website and hope you will consider Pacer, to help you find what ever electronic wire or cable, you are looking for.
about:
Pacer Electronic Wire & Cable, Inc. operates from Chandler, Arizona, and has served businesses across the United States for more than three decades. Established as a regional supplier, the business grew into a national distributor without disclosing its founding year or ownership structure.

The company maintains an inventory of UL-listed and Mil-Spec wire, multi-conductor cable, coaxial cable, heat-shrink tubing, sleeving, and cable ties. Its value-added services include wire re-spooling, cutting, tinning, and crimping of Amp/Tyco and Molex terminals, as well as wire stripping and twisting.

Pacer serves a broad base of commercial and industrial clients, offering product lines such as plenum cables, military-specification wire, marine shipboard cables, coaxial dual-shield cables, instrumentation cables, and computer cables. The company works with manufacturers including Harbour Industries and RSCC Aero Defense to source its stock.

Founded on a service-first philosophy, Pacer emphasizes knowledgeable sales support and quick turnaround on value-added processing to meet specific customer requirements. The company states that service is its first priority, aiming to provide friendly, knowledgeable assistance for electronic wire needs.
